content.text: Who are the top spenders in the game?

The top spenders are whale segment players with high combat power, extensive character collections, and multiple legendary heroes. They make purchases across categories including Crystal Packs, Character Shards, Hyperdrive Bundles, and Starter Packs via credit card, PayPal, and digital wallet.
What are the key KPIs I should track for this game?

Key KPIs include ARPU by segment, player retention rates (D1/D7/D30), session duration and quality scores, arena battle win rates, guild participation rates, daily activity completion rates, purchase conversion rates by category, campaign ROI, and incident impact metrics.
Analyze player segments: whale, dolphin, f2p_hardcore, casual

Whale players have the highest combat power (15M+), top arena ranks, and 7+ legendary heroes. Dolphins have moderate combat power (9M+) and good engagement. F2P hardcore players are highly active with high levels but lower spending. Casual players have low levels, low combat power, and minimal legendary heroes.
Which acquisition channels have the best ROI?

Organic has the lowest CPI at ~$1.91 but limited scale. Referral ranges $2.65-$9.46. Facebook and search channels cost $8-$14 per install but can deliver high LTV players ($200-$400). Campaign CAMP_001 via search_engine shows strong LTV. The best ROI comes from organic and referral channels, while paid channels deliver volume.
Show me the performance of our marketing campaigns

Five campaigns are tracked: Summer Legends Event ($76K budget, search_engine, returning players), New Player Welcome ($63K, facebook, new players), Holiday Special Offer ($60K, search_engine, all players, completed), Arena Championship ($78K, mobile_ads, returning players, completed), and Guild Wars Promotion ($96K, facebook, whales, active).
What are the current real-time battle error rates?

The response should query live metrics for battle_error events, showing total count, breakdown by platform (iOS/Android) and region, and compare against the threshold of 100 events per 2 minutes. It should indicate whether the current rate is normal, elevated, or critical.
What incidents have affected the most players?

The most impactful incidents include INC_0001 (server_downtime, 7,127 players), INC_0004 (performance_degradation, 9,375 players), INC_0007 (login_issues, 8,037 players), and INC_0003 (feature_bug, 6,050 players). The most severe was INC_0008 (critical server_downtime, 674 players, $412 compensation).
Compare player retention across acquisition channels

Retention varies by channel: some players show D1 retention but drop by D7 (early churn), others show delayed engagement with D30 retention but not D1. First purchase timing ranges from weeks to months post-install. Organic and referral channels tend to show better long-term retention than paid channels.
What game modes have the longest session times?

Story mode has the longest sessions at up to 175 minutes. Fleet battles reach 160 minutes. Guild raids range 91-159 minutes. Arena battles span 80-154 minutes. Challenges average around 105 minutes. Difficulty levels include easy, normal, hard, and heroic.
What types of social interactions happen between players?

Social interactions include guild_chat, guild_invite, friend_request, ally_code_share, strategy_discussion, raid_coordination, and private_message. Sentiment is tracked as positive, negative, or neutral. Guild context interactions tend to have higher engagement. Influence scores range from 0 to 1.
